svg.text: Controlled federated DDoS lab: topology and routing
Proposal v2.2 for owner review · isolated colima VM · IPv4 only · no NAT
detection only; no filtering or mitigation
root-namespace guard on lab bridges · no route out of the VM · IPv6 off · no NAT
OP = forwarded IPv4 toward a customer /24, metered once at its own BR
services: TCP listen · UDP sink · HTTP
services: TCP listen · UDP sink · HTTP
no BGP-to-OSPF or OSPF-to-BGP redistribution; default route inside
Fallback (pre-registered, before data): static routing everywhere
example data path, attack + benign: site → TR-A → BR-1 → PE-1 → CE-1 → CUST-1
reflection path: reflector → victim (own address, no spoofing)
